title: The AI boom is helping Samsung and coming for Apple
title_zh: 人工智能热潮正在帮助三星，也将惠及苹果
summary: Samsung is using the AI chip shortage to juice its margins. That could hurt Apple.
summary_zh: 三星正在利用人工智能芯片的短缺来提高利润。这可能会伤害苹果。

title: Retail traders aren't just 'dumb money' anymore: Here's why
title_zh: 零售交易者不再只是“傻钱”：原因如下
summary: Gen Z and millennial retail investors are becoming more sophisticated, according to a new survey from eToro (ETOR). These groups have been diversifying into assets beyond just equities, regularly reviewing their portfolios, and more.
summary_zh: eToro (ETOR) 的一项新调查显示，Z 世代和千禧一代散户投资者正变得更加成熟。这些集团一直在多元化投资股票以外的资产，并定期审查其投资组合等。

title: Gold price hits three-week high on fresh Trump tariff jitters
title_zh: 由于新的特朗普关税紧张情绪，金价触及三周高位
summary: Tariff uncertainty is pushing traders toward the precious metal.
summary_zh: 关税的不确定性正在推动交易者转向贵金属。

title: How to make the most of your bonus pay
title_zh: 如何充分利用您的奖金
summary: Around one in four UK employees get a bonus but to make it work hard for you, it’s key to avoid the bonus bear traps.
summary_zh: 大约四分之一的英国员工获得奖金，但为了让奖金为你工作，避免奖金熊陷阱是关键。

title: SK Hynix Boss Pledges to Boost Output of AI Memory Chips
title_zh: SK海力士老板承诺提高AI存储芯片产量
summary: The chipmaker’s share price has more than quadrupled over the past year on record earnings.
summary_zh: 这家芯片制造商的股价在过去一年里上涨了四倍多，盈利创历史新高。

title: ‘Money's moving out of tech’: Wall Street weighs stock market winners amid the AI scare trade
title_zh: “资金正在从科技领域转移”：华尔街在人工智能恐慌交易中权衡股市赢家
summary: Investors are rotating out of the most popular tech stocks. Here's where they are finding gains.
summary_zh: 投资者正在从最受欢迎的科技股中撤出。这就是他们发现收益的地方。

title: Here's Walmart's $1 trillion secret
title_zh: 这是沃尔玛 1 万亿美元的秘密
summary: Walmart remains no joke on tech.
summary_zh: 沃尔玛在科技方面始终不开玩笑。

title: Nvidia earnings, SCOTUS tariff fallout, geopolitical tensions rise: What to watch this week
title_zh: 英伟达财报、最高法院关税影响、地缘政治紧张局势加剧：本周值得关注的内容
summary: In the upcoming week, investor attention will focus on fallout from the Supreme Court's tariff ruling, tensions in Iran, and Nvidia's fourth quarter earnings.
summary_zh: 未来一周，投资者的注意力将集中在最高法院关税裁决的影响、伊朗的紧张局势以及英伟达第四季度的收益上。

title: Nvidia is moving in on Intel and AMD's home turf
title_zh: Nvidia 正在进军英特尔和 AMD 的主场
summary: Nvidia is getting into the CPU server market, and that could be trouble for Intel and AMD.
summary_zh: Nvidia 正在进军 CPU 服务器市场，这可能会给英特尔和 AMD 带来麻烦。
